mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, user_id, member_role, status, joined_at, updated_at FROM `conversation_member` WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 0 ORDER BY joined_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT user_id FROM `conversation_member` WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 0

SELECT cm1.conversation_id FROM `conversation_member` cm1 INNER JOIN `conversation_member` cm2 ON cm2.conversation_id = cm1.conversation_id AND cm2.user_id = #{rightUserId} AND cm2.status = 0 INNER JOIN `conversation` c ON c.id = cm1.conversation_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.conversation_type = 'SINGLE' WHERE cm1.user_id = #{leftUserId} AND cm1.status = 0
